subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: After the four deterministic guard expectations are updated and exact-head checks pass, does the security owner approve this grouped set of official immutable action revisions?
rationale: The patch itself has mechanical test defects, while the protected security label and secret-bearing workflows require an explicit owner decision that automation cannot supply.

options.title: Approve after guard repair
options.body: Keep the grouped official action updates, fix the four assertions, and land after rebased exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged action families
options.body: Separate token, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex action bumps if the owner prefers narrower approval and rollout boundaries.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Defer this PR if the branch cannot reach a stable reviewed head or the security owner does not approve the combined revisions.

recommendation.title: Approve after guard repair
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped official action updates, fix the four assertions, and land after rebased exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current guard expectations and has the strongest recent history across the affected CI and performance workflow surfaces; CODEOWNERS separately routes the security-specific files to the security operations team.
